claude_only.name: Which identifier authoritatively distinguishes this service offering from every other offering of the same provider?
How is the offering classified by category, service type and specialty, and against which governed code systems?
Which delivery modalities does the offering support, and is each modality independently deliverable?
What is the offering's active status and effective period, and what supersedes it when it is withdrawn or replaced?
Which provider organization and internal delivery unit is accountable for the offering at each location?
At which physical, mobile, home or virtual locations is the offering delivered, and how is a virtual delivery point represented?
How are many-to-many bindings between offerings, locations and delivery units represented without duplicating the location or organization record?
Under whose authority is a practitioner role authorized to deliver this service at this location?
What is the authorization period of the role, and how are lapses, suspensions and renewals represented here without restating licensure?
Which services and locations does the role cover, and how is the role kept distinct from the person holding it?
Is the offering covered by at least the minimum authorized roles for each operating period, and what state applies when it is not?
What distinguishes an unfilled establishment post from a temporarily uncovered operating period, and which of the two is recorded here?
What evidence and observation time support a coverage assertion, and how confident is it?
What are the published operating hours and time zone of the offering at each delivery location?
How are planned closures, holiday exceptions and unplanned suspensions of published availability represented?
How does published availability differ from bookable supply, and which system of record owns each?
Through which channels can the offering be reached, is a referral or appointment required, and by which method are referrals accepted?
What capacity type, unit and quantity are asserted, and over which period or at which instant?
Does the quantity count physical stock, staffed and immediately available capacity, or surge and overflow capacity, and which definition profile applies?
Which system asserted the capacity, when was it observed, and when was it received here?
To which authority and on what cadence must this capacity be reported, and under which instrument?
At which instant is occupancy measured, and is the value a single-instant snapshot or an aggregation over a reporting period?
Which capacity statement is the denominator for an occupancy figure, and are surge and overflow units included in it?
When must small-number occupancy values be suppressed or aggregated before they are disclosed?
Which tracer items must be present for this offering to count as ready, and to which readiness domain does each belong?
By what method, on which date and by which assessor was readiness observed?
Which external inventory, workforce or estates records does a readiness item reference rather than restate?
How is a composite readiness index derived from domain scores, and what does a missing domain do to it?
Which eligibility conditions and qualifying comments apply to the offering, and against which policy are they defined?
Which authority sets each eligibility rule, and in which jurisdiction or profile does it apply?
Where is an individual person's eligibility determination recorded, given that this model holds only the service-level rule?
Which population or geographic area does the offering serve, and is service refused outside it?
Which languages and communication supports are available, and are they available for every modality?
Which physical-access and reasonable-adjustment attributes are asserted, and against which standard are they coded?
Which identifier distinguishes a queue entry, and how are duplicate registrations for the same demand detected?
Which priority or clinical urgency class is assigned, under which scheme, and who may change it?
How is the subject of the demand referenced without inlining any clinical or demographic content?
Which offering, delivery unit or unnamed service pool is the demand registered against?
Which event starts the waiting clock for this offering, and does a re-referral start a new clock or continue the existing one?
Under what conditions does the clock pause or exclude days, and how are those periods evidenced?
How are completed waits distinguished from ongoing waits that are still censored when a waiting time is published?
Which jurisdiction profile supplies the clock rules in force, and what happens to entries created under a superseded profile?
Which terminal and non-terminal states may a queue entry take, and which transitions between them are permitted?
What reason vocabulary explains a removal that is not a fulfilment, and who may record it?
How are offers, refusals and non-attendance recorded so that they do not silently reset the waiting measure?
Which capacity unit, authorized role and location are committed, and against which queue entry or referral?
How does a supply-side capacity commitment differ from the patient-facing appointment record, and which model owns each?
Which events release a committed capacity unit, and is the released capacity returned to the same period?
Which identifier follows a referral across the sending and receiving organizations?
Is the referral directed to a named offering, a delivery unit, a location or an unnamed pool, and how is that expressed?
How is urgency expressed on a referral, and under which coded scheme?
How is the clinical reason for a referral referenced without copying clinical content into this model?
Which dispositions may a referral reach, and which actor is entitled to set each one?
When a referral is redirected, is it the same referral or a new one, and how is the chain preserved?
What time targets apply between referral sent, acknowledged and accepted, and how is a breach recorded?
Which sending and receiving offering, delivery unit and location are party to the transfer?
At which milestone does delivery responsibility pass from the sending to the receiving service?
Which milestones are timestamped, and what is recorded when a milestone is missing?
What is recorded when a transfer fails or continuity of delivery is broken?
Which encounter identifier and issuing system are carried here, and how is the reference resolved?
Which delivery-side keys are attached to an encounter reference?
Which encounter fields must never be copied into this model, and what is the fallback when the contained model is unavailable?
Can one encounter satisfy more than one queue entry or referral, and how is that represented?
Which quality management system or standard does the delivery unit assert, and over which scope of offerings and sites?
Which quality dimensions does a stated commitment address?
What evidence supports a certification or accreditation claim, and where is the certificate of record held?
What are the initial population, denominator, numerator and exclusion criteria of the measure?
Which stratifiers and supplemental data are required, and which are prohibited because they would re-identify small groups?
Which measure inputs are owned by other models, and how are they resolved without recomputing their state?
Is an increase or a decrease in the measure an improvement, and what scoring method and unit apply?
Which measure version, input artifacts and computation run produced this result?
What reporting period and time zone does the result cover, and when was it computed and published?
Which definitional or coverage differences prevent this result from being compared with another jurisdiction or period?
What kind of disruption is declared, and against which severity scale?
Which offerings, locations and populations are affected, and are alternatives named?
When did the disruption start, when was it declared, and what restoration time is expected?
To whom is the declaration escalated, and where is any resulting investigation record held?
Which steward owns each record class in this model?
On what basis does a steward assert authority to publish or amend a record class?
What happens to stewardship when a provider organization merges, closes or transfers a service?
Who attested to the accuracy of a directory record, and at what instant?
Against which primary source and by what method was an attested field verified?
How stale may a verified field become before it must be re-verified or marked unreliable?
Which identifier is authoritative for a record when several systems issue one?
Which of event time, observation time and ingestion time does a given field carry, and are all three required?
How is a superseded record version linked to its replacement and to the agent that made the change?
What provenance must this model hold, and what belongs to the external audit trail?
Which fields may appear in each named projection, and which are excluded by construction?
For which purpose and recipient class is each projection released?
What aggregation or suppression must be applied before a capacity, queue or flow projection is published?
Which model evaluates and enforces a release decision, given that this model only declares the constraint?
Which retention class applies to each record class in this model, and which policy sets its period?
How is a legal hold recorded, and what does it suspend?
What must survive deletion as a tombstone so that references from other models do not dangle?
What evidence proves that a disposition was executed, and which model holds that evidence?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative master-system identifier of this provider, which registry minted it, and which governed IRIs or Dimension ULIDs are secondary?
How is the provider classified (ICHA-HP class, local organization type, hospital/clinic/practice/EMS/pharmacy/lab/LTC) and which classification system is binding in this jurisdiction?
What human-readable names, aliases, contacts and description distinguish this provider from similarly named legal entities or from the facilities it operates?
Which evidence and provenance support this registry entry (source directory, last-change time, attestation)?
What is the provider record status (active/inactive), open and close event times, and which successor or predecessor identifiers apply after merger, split or re-coding?
What hierarchical parent (partOf) and which non-hierarchical affiliations (HIE, IDN, network, reporting, supply chain) exist, with role codes and effective periods?
Who owns this registry record, which authority may inactivate it, and which access exceptions apply to contact data of providers or practitioners?
What identifiers are specific to this role or location occupancy, and which person reference (or explicit unnamed occupancy) does it bind?
What profession (WHO/ISCO grouping), role codes and specialties apply, and to which capability identifiers do they bind without copying the capability model?
For what period is the person authorised in these roles, which boards or organizations issued registration or privileges, and is this a standing, locum or disaster-credential occupancy?
When did authorisation start or end as a real-world event, versus when was that fact ingested, and who attested it?
For which provider organization, facilities and care services does this role practise?
What routine availability windows and not-available periods apply to this role instance, and are they the same across all linked services and locations?
Which electronic endpoints or contact points belong to this role rather than to the person or the organization, and which must be suppressed from public directory projections?
What master-facility identifier uniquely identifies this site nationally, and what Location plus Organization pairing constitutes the IHE Facility?
Is this an instance or a kind, what service-delivery location type applies, and what parent/child locations form the campus-bed or jurisdiction hierarchy?
How is the facility located and contacted for care discovery without owning cadastral geometry (address, geocode, coverage jurisdiction)?
What is the facility's general status versus bed/room operational status, and at which event time did that status become true versus when was it observed?
What are the service hours, availability exceptions, and commissioning or closure event times including temporary field or converted sites?
Which constraints (infection isolation, radiation licence, CLIA, pharmacy authority) apply to this facility as facts, and which regulator owns enforcement?
What identifiers, names and coded category/type/specialty identify this care service offering, and which generic service record does it extend?
Which organization provides it, at which locations or coverage areas, and is the location virtual, home-based, mobile or fixed?
If this is a schedulable specialisation, which generic service is it offeredIn, and is the offering record active (as opposed to temporarily notAvailable)?
What eligibility criteria and programs constrain who may receive this service, and which profile or jurisdiction owns those rules?
How are referrals accepted (method, questionnaires), is an appointment required, and what languages or characteristics apply?
What availability is published on the offering itself versus delegated to Schedule/Slot, and who may see costing if present?
Which facility and service does this statement quantify, in what unit, for what period, and what quantities are licensed, staffed, available, occupied, isolated, closed or surge?
What counting method, confidence and evidence produced this snapshot, and what were the census event time versus ingestion time?
Is this snapshot shareable as a public heatmap, and what small-number suppression or facility-omission rules apply?
Has capacity been reclassified (for example ward to ICU, hotel to field hospital) and what constraint or crisis-standards profile authorised the conversion?
Which actors (service, role, location, device) does this schedule apply to, and what is its planning horizon?
For each slot, what are start and end (RFC 3339 with seconds and offset), status, overbook flag and comments or constraints?
If a slot is consumed by a named booking, what waiting-list or referral identifier reserved it, and which nested encounter (WM-ACT-018) later fulfilled it without this model owning the encounter?
For which facility, service and period is coverage stated, by which cadre or named practitioner-role references, as rostered headcount versus on-call?
What minimum-staffing or supervision constraints apply (for example a trainee must be supervised), and which policy profile owns them without this model evaluating compliance?
Are emergency or disaster privileges in effect, and what is the coverage event time versus roster ingestion time?
Which facility or service is excepted, for what period, and of what kind (holiday, maintenance, divert, evacuation, industrial action, contamination, crisis standards)?
Does a profile-specific emergency-acceptance obligation override divert, and which statute or policy URI states that without this model enforcing it?
Who declared the exception, at what event time versus ingestion time, and what recovery or safe state is planned?
What identifiers distinguish this request, is it a referral or a transfer, and which person or episode references does it carry without inlining clinical content?
What are source and target (organization, service, facility, role), coded service, intent, status, priority or urgency, and replacement or basedOn links?
When was the request authored as an event, when received by the target, when ingested, and which nested encounter (if any) later fulfilled it?
What constraints (prior authorisation required, eligibility, urgency class) apply as recorded facts, and which engine, not this model, evaluates them?
What pathway or entry identifier (with issuing organisation) identifies this queued demand, for which service or facility, and which person or episode is referenced?
What priority class and clock status apply, and what are clock start, stop, pause and removal event times versus ingestion time?
Which referral created this entry, which slot or booking reserved it, and which nested encounter stopped the clock without this model executing the encounter?
What waiting duration was measured, by which methodology, and is the value reportable given small-number and identifiable-person constraints?
What WM-ACT-018 encounter instance identifier is contained under this delivery system, and which facility, service offering and practitioner roles are the parent-side bindings?
Which person or personal-health episode reference is passed through to the child without duplication, and which referral or waiting entry does this encounter fulfil?
When did this parent observe a notification that the nested instance opened or closed, as ingestion time distinct from the encounter's own event times owned by WM-ACT-018?
Which projection (public directory, professional referral search, internal network, capacity heatmap) is being served, and which finding classes are included or omitted?
What electronic endpoints are published for this organization or affiliation, with connection type, managing organization for support, and applicable network context?
For federated ingest, what is the source directory, last-update watermark, conflict-resolution policy, and deprecation status of each entry?
What licence or accreditation identifiers apply to this provider or facility, issued by whom, of what type, for what scope and period?
What is the recorded status (valid, suspended, revoked, expired), at which event time, and where is the evidence, without this model executing the suspension?
Is this authorisation a jurisdiction-specific profile (not universal), and which conflicting national schemes must not be treated as equivalent?
Who owns this record, who has oversight access, and under which access model (not implemented here) is disclosure granted?
What reporting obligation (capacity, waiting, directory update) applies, at what cadence, to which authority, and what validation was performed (schema, identity, referential, not clinical)?

What retention period and disposition class apply, is a tombstone required, and which retention-policy model executes physical deletion while this model forbids silent erase of identifiers and succession?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
